title.en: Chapter 14 — The Sound on the River

sentences.ar: بعد الظهر التاني، سمعوا صوت من بعيد.
sentences.en: The second afternoon, they heard a sound from afar.
Boom.
A deep sound, from the river.
Joe said: what was that?
Huck said: thunder?
Tom said: no.
Listen.
And a minute later, boom again.
They ran to the shore, and looked at the river.

sentences.ar: كانت الباخرة الزغيرة تبع القرية، ماشية بنص النهر.
sentences.en: It was the village's little steamboat, moving down the middle of the river.
With many people on it.

sentences.ar: وكل شوي، بيطلع دخان من جنبها، وبعدين بوم.
sentences.en: And every so often, smoke came from her side, and then boom.
Huck said: they are firing a cannon at the water!
Tom said: I know why!
That is what they do when someone drowns.

sentences.ar: صوت المدفع بيخلي الجثة تطلع عالسطح.
sentences.en: The sound of the cannon makes the body rise to the surface.
And the three were silent, and understood all at once.
Joe said: they are looking for us.
They think we drowned.
And Tom's face began to shine.

sentences.ar: قال: يعني القرية كلها بتحكي عنا!
sentences.en: He said: that means the whole village is talking about us!

sentences.ar: والناس بتبكي، والأولاد بيحسدونا، وإحنا أبطال!
sentences.en: The people are crying, the boys envy us, and we are heroes!

sentences.ar: وحس إنه هاي أحلى لحظة بحياته.
sentences.en: And he felt it was the finest moment of his life.
But Joe was not happy.

sentences.ar: كان بيتخيل أمه، وهي واقفة عالشط، وبتبكي.
sentences.en: He was imagining his mother, standing on the shore, crying.

sentences.ar: وهَك كان يفكر: مين رح يبكي عليّ؟
sentences.en: And Huck was thinking: who is going to cry over me?

sentences.ar: وإجا الليل، والباخرة رجعت، والنهر رجع هادي.
sentences.en: And night came, and the steamboat went back, and the river went quiet again.
And two slept.
And Tom did not.
He sat thinking of Aunt Polly.

sentences.ar: وكل ما يفكر، يشوفها تبكي، وهو ما بيتحمل هالصورة.
sentences.en: And every time he thought, he saw her crying, and he could not bear that picture.

sentences.ar: وبعد نص الليل، قام على مهل، وكتب إشي على قطعة لحا بالطبشور.
sentences.en: And after midnight, he got up slowly, and wrote something on a piece of bark with chalk.

sentences.ar: وحطها بجيبه، وحط قطعة تانية جنب جو.
sentences.en: And put it in his pocket, and put another piece beside Joe.
And walked to the shore, and went into the water.
